service.en: Register for social affairs utility exemptions
service.ar: التسجيل في إعفاءات الشؤون الاجتماعية للمرافق
service.ur: سماجی امور کی چھوٹ کے لیے رجسٹریشن

about: People under a social assistance agreement register to receive utility bill exemptions.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. The form itself sits behind UAE PASS sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Customer must be listed under a social assistance agreement issued by the Ministry of Community Empowerment
documents: Social Affairs letter from the Ministry of Community Empowerment
Power of attorney, if applying through an agent
channels: Sign in with UAE PASS on TAMM (website or app) or another available channel
